children: ) today announced that it has been named an OpenAI Advanced Partner within the OpenAI Partner Network, reinforcing Insight's position as a provider of AI solutions for midmarket and lower-enterprise organizations seeking to accelerate AI adoption.

As part of the expanded relationship, Insight will work with OpenAI to help organizations build, deploy, and scale AI solutions responsibly and effectively. The expanded relationship reflects Insight's experience helping organizations successfully deploy and scale AI.

“Insight has built a repeatable approach that connects technology, process transformation, and workforce adoption so clients can move from pilots to production and results faster,” said Jack Azagury, Insight President and CEO. “As an OpenAI Advanced Partner, we can help more organizations deploy AI responsibly, scale across the enterprise, and realize value at speed.”

Combining OpenAI's frontier models and products with Insight's expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and digital transformation, the companies are addressing the data, governance, adoption, and operational challenges that often prevent AI initiatives from delivering measurable business outcomes. This work will help organizations put GPT-6 Astra to work across more of their business, using deeper reasoning and computer use to complete complex workflows and deliver finished work.

To meet growing demand, Insight is investing in a dedicated OpenAI Center of Excellence (COE) and expanding specialized capabilities across its sales, solution architecture, engineering, and forward-deployed expert teams. Through its Radius™ offerings, Insight helps its clients adopt and scale ChatGPT Enterprise, Codex, agentic solutions, and custom AI applications.

Insight supports clients across every stage of their AI journey — from strategy and governance to implementation, adoption, managed services, and continuous optimization. Insight and OpenAI will collaborate on client adoption, AI-powered service offerings, industry solutions, and joint go-to-market initiatives.

Insight's approach is informed by its own AI transformation journey, which has driven AI adoption across more than 90% of its global workforce and generated significant productivity gains. Drawing on lessons learned from deploying AI internally at scale, Insight is positioned to bring OpenAI capabilities to midmarket organizations, helping them identify high-value AI opportunities and accelerate deployment while maintaining strong governance, security, and compliance practices.

"Successful AI transformation requires both breakthrough technology and proven delivery expertise," said Colleen Kapase, Vice President of Strategic Global Partnerships and Ecosystems at OpenAI. "Insight's customer reach, technical capabilities, and focus on business outcomes make them a valuable partner for organizations adopting AI. Working together, we can help more organizations accelerate the journey from AI exploration to real-world impact.”
Learn more about the OpenAI Partner Network: https://openai.com/business/partners/
To learn how Insight can help your organization accelerate AI adoption, visit our website.

Insight Enterprises is a leading Solutions Integrator that helps clients solve technology challenges by combining the right hardware, software, and services.
